scope: Local macOS arm64 verification for long tasks, restart recovery and CLI upgrade compatibility

commands: make test (Go vet, go test -race -shuffle=on ./..., native CLI integration, frontend lint/typecheck/54 tests)
go run ./cmd/contract && npm --prefix web run generate (stable on repeated generation)
review counterexample tests (overlay, race) now pass in nativecli/proc/workflow
results: Long-task defaults and separate run/step/first-response/stall reasons
Graceful stop leaves a running checkpoint; restart creates a new attempt and keeps partial history
Canceled runs do not revive; duplicate engines dispatch each step once
Crash window does not repeat completed steps or republish artifacts
Failed delegation still returns to the coordinator after restart, matching normal scheduling
Parallel partial completion retries only the incomplete step
Owned residual process group is verified and fully terminated; identity mismatch is not signaled and blocks resume; live ownership blocks thread deletion
Capability, connection-config or changed resolved-model/upstream blocks preserve a checkpoint; explicit resume rechecks and continues only when safe
Connection identity records resolved model, provider/endpoint identity and program identity without secrets; legacy attempts without identity require a new run
CLI version/identity change between attempts is re-detected and recorded
Dependency waiting does not consume a running step's deadline
Unknown optional CLI notifications are recorded; unknown tool actions, missing terminal results and session identity changes fail closed
Claude status/idle notifications do not reset the stall deadline
A stale liveness warning is cleared by subsequent tool or message progress in the UI
Artifact publication retries replace the staged, not-yet-committed version; only one artifact is committed

real_cli_restart.execution_mode: Production server, installed Claude CLI, scoped MCP bridge, synthetic local text files only
real_cli_restart.workspace: Temporary isolated synthetic workspace with two text fixtures; no private data
real_cli_restart.restart_point: First analyst attempt had started: process ownership and native session were persisted, and the server was SIGKILLed

residual_process.verification: PID plus process start time matched the persisted attempt ownership; the whole recorded process group was then verified
residual_process.action: verified and terminated the entire platform-owned process group after the leader exited

first_attempt.error: service restarted; the owned process group was stopped and its result is unknown; continuing from saved context

second_analyst_attempt.note: No native session was replayed; the platform used persisted task context and committed inputs.

recovery.history: The interrupted first attempt remained in the attempt history. The reviewer ran once after the resumed analyst. Completed-step and artifact non-repetition are covered separately by automated crash-window tests because this restart point had no completed step yet.
recovery.connection_identity: recorded resolved model and non-secret upstream identity; matched after restart (no provider/model switch)

remaining_limits: Owned-process reclamation verifies the recorded PID, process start time and process group. A descendant that creates a new session/process group outside that group is not reaped; the adapters restrict native tools so this path should not normally occur.
The adapters use ephemeral isolated native sessions. A new attempt continues from persisted context and never claims to have resumed the old native session.
Stall detection warns by default; operators may opt into termination with COCOGEM_STALL_ACTION=stop. Run and step limits remain finite in either mode.
not_executed: An actual CLI package upgrade during a live run; upgrade/replacement is covered by automated identity and recheck tests, not by a package-manager upgrade.
Any claim that all future CLI versions are compatible; compatibility and isolation are re-probed per program identity and unknown capabilities fail closed.
Gemini live model success: its existing upstream rejects the native API protocol; no credentials were changed.
GitHub-hosted CI, Linux runtime, and real-provider quality evaluation.

issues.fix: Attempt records resolved model and non-secret connection identity; recovery/resume compares it and blocks changed default model/provider/endpoint while preserving a checkpoint.
Recovery no longer settles a run merely because a delegated step failed; pending continuations are scheduled and can consume the failure result, matching non-restart behavior.
Terminate verifies and waits for the entire recorded process group, escalates to SIGKILL, and reconciliation/deletion treats any surviving group member as owned/uncertain.

Check is help/installation candidate only. Production dispatch/recovery runs an actual installed-CLI protocol and tool-boundary probe against a local fake model; failure blocks the call and the page shows candidate/unavailable instead of confirmed.
Unknown events are structurally inspected for tool/command/permission/action keys and types; unknown actions fail closed while confirmable optional notifications remain allowed.
Claude system status/idle notifications update diagnostics only, not progress; they cannot suppress stall detection.
Active liveness is derived from warning plus subsequent progress events; tool completion, text, step/attempt/recovery transitions clear stale warnings.

regression_tests: App test: clears a stale tool-wait warning after confirmed progress

real_cli_restart_matrix.harness: Production server, installed CLIs, isolated synthetic fixture (17+25=42), scoped MCP, code_analysis analyst then reviewer; SIGKILL after native process/session persisted, restart on same temporary SQLite. The review harness set a 90s first-response window; one Codex retry hit that harness limit, so the successful retry used a 5m harness window (product default remains 10m).

claude.attempts: analyst attempt 1 interrupted by owned_process_reclaimed; attempt 2 succeeded from context; reviewer succeeded once

codex.attempts: analyst attempt 1 interrupted by owned_process_reclaimed; attempt 2 succeeded from context; reviewer succeeded once; one earlier retry hit the review harness's 90s first-response window, then passed with a 5m harness window
codex.transient_observation: One real retry timed out after 90s with last event turn.started; it was not treated as unsupported, and a later retry with a 5m window passed. This demonstrates why first-response time is configurable and separate from version/isolation.

gemini.attempts: analyst attempt 1 interrupted after its process group exited; attempt 2 failed
gemini.error: native CLI did not confirm success (category=connection); no credentials were changed and the existing upstream/native API configuration remains incompatible
gemini.classification: not a version-unsupported decision and no credential or login change was requested

real_cli_restart_matrix.not_claimed: All restart points are before the first step completed; completed-step and artifact non-repetition remain covered by automated crash-window tests. Gemini real success is not claimed.
